stats.notes: IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023 first-time students): 15,201 applicants, 11,511 admitted, 2,391 enrolled. College Navigator fall 2024: 13,095 applicants, 89% admitted. IPEDS reports no nonresident-alien applicant counts for NMSU, so international admit figures are null; nonresidents are about 3% of undergraduates (fall 2024, rounded). Undergraduate enrollment 12,507 and 16:1 ratio are fall 2024. No readable Common Data Set was found for this college, so this is the IPEDS baseline; GPA, residency and class-rank details are not included.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition and fees in-state $8,183, out-of-state $25,307; on-campus food and housing $12,282, other $4,536; total_coa_usd is the out-of-state on-campus total. NMSU's International Competitive Scholarship can reduce an international student's tuition to the in-state rate (see aid notes).
